_comment: User stories told as the roles this instance owns: what a reader acting in the role is trying to do. Each story points at its role (`role`); the role names none of them (#1168). Moved here with their roles from the harness's scenarios/stories.json (move M4). Schema: the harness's schemas/user-story.ts.
name: folio-assistant-core

stories.want: Answer a question whose evidence is spread across several held documents
Decide, per question, whether summaries or chunks are the right granularity to search
Stop an iterative search on a stated sufficiency condition rather than on exhaustion
Report an answer with citations a reader can verify at the page it came from
Frame a searchable question from a vague one
Appraise source quality rather than just retrieve
Report an empty result as a real answer
Tell which repository it is in and what that implies
Run the right first commands before touching anything
Find the skill that governs the task instead of improvising
